# laravelforge_org_team_recipe_share (Resource)

Shares an existing recipe with a team in a Laravel Forge organization. This is a link between a team and a recipe; the recipe itself is managed elsewhere. There is no update endpoint, so changing any attribute recreates the share.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `recipe_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the recipe to share with the team.
- `team_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the team the recipe is shared with.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Recipe creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) Name of the shared recipe.
- `script` (String) Shell script executed by the recipe.
- `updated_at` (String) Recipe last-update timestamp.
- `user` (String) User the recipe runs as.
